halloween.costume: a homemade robot costume: a small brown cardboard box worn over its body, with rough hand-cut holes for its wings, legs, and neck, partly covered in crinkled aluminum foil held on with visible strips of tape, with bottle-cap dials and a few colorful buttons glued to the front, and a thin foil-covered cardboard headband across the crown of its head, with a bendy-straw antenna rising straight up from the top of its head, tipped with a bottle cap
props: a tiny orange jack-o'-lantern candy pail hanging from a cord around its neck, like a necklace
halloween.caption: Beep Boop Coo
